_comment: Malaysia import duty amendments made AFTER the Customs Duties Order 2025 [P.U. (A) 384/2025], the edition data/my_tariff_source parses. Applied by build_duty_rates.py build_my and build_explorer_dataset.py on every build. Each entry names the lines it changes, the rate P.U. (A) 384 prints for each (the parsed gazette must still show it, or the build stops: the base edition has moved on and this overlay needs review), the rate it substitutes, its commencement, and the gazetted instrument. The P.U. (A) 384 row is never rewritten: it keeps its rate and ends the day before commencement, and the amended rate follows as a dated scheduled row, so /api/duty-rates serves each on its own dates without a rebuild.
_coverage: Not an inventory of every amendment. Only the orders listed here have been read (2026-11-19). Customs Duties (Amendment) Orders made since 2025-11-01 have not otherwise been surveyed.

rate_amendments.summary: Import duty on 7115.90.10 00 (other articles of precious metal: of gold or silver) from 10% to 0%
rate_amendments.title: Customs Duties (Amendment) Order 2026
rate_amendments.amends: Customs Duties Order 2025 [P.U. (A) 384/2025], First Schedule, column (5)

instruments.effect: Para. 2: the Customs Duties Order 2025 [P.U. (A) 384/2025] is amended in the First Schedule, in relation to subheading 7115.90.10 00, in column (5), by substituting for the words "10%" the words "0%". Para. 1(2): comes into operation on 1 November 2026. No other line or column is amended.
